items.title: JPMorgan, Visa Warn of Cyberattack That Hit Outside Vendor
items.summary:
Devon Ackerman, LevelBlue, Global Leader for Digital Forensics and Incident Response, joined Bloomberg's Paul Sweeney and Scarlet Fu  to discuss the recent onslaught of outages and cyber attacks.
JPMorgan Chase & Co., Visa Inc. and Mastercard Inc. said some customer information was accessed in a cyberattack on a vendor.
JPMorgan said it believes, based on an investigation so far, that hackers accessed marketing data held by an outside firm, which may include customer names and email addresses. The bank said the issue isn't related to an outage it faced earlier this week.
